Tanker reports an explosion while passing through a busy shipping channel

A tanker reported an explosion while traveling through a major international shipping lane, according to an official maritime notification issued earlier today.

The vessel's crew reported that everyone remained safe and that the ship was continuing under its own power while authorities reviewed the report.

Investigators were still working to determine what happened, and the initial report did not establish any connection to other nearby incidents.

Officials referred readers to the maritime notice for additional details on the continuing investigation.
